selection: GMRES for nonsymmetric coupled velocity-pressure matrix; native PETSc overlapping ASM with local ILU(2) retains coupling and requires no additional packages. One fixed PC candidate.
xml_preconditioner: petsc-jacobi is the supported XML initializer; KSPSetFromOptions overrides PC to ASM before setup. No claim of runtime Jacobi.

residual_equivalence.matrix: On free DOFs W_ii=1/sqrt(abs(A_ii)), with W_ii=1 for a zero diagonal. Both implementations assemble W A W and W b; fixed DOFs have zero correction and RHS.
residual_equivalence.norm: Right-preconditioned GMRES with unpreconditioned norm measures the residual of the diagonally scaled system; no PC-norm relaxation. Zero initial guess implies initial residual = W b.
residual_equivalence.criterion: ||W(b-Ax)||_2 < max(1e-10 ||Wb||_2, 1e-24), same numerical threshold and scaling formula as frozen FSILS NS.
residual_equivalence.caveat: Different parallel reductions and boundary representation need not be bitwise identical. FSILS NS recursively updates squared residual and can reset failed diagnostics to zero. PETSc monitor independently reports true residual; do not interpret historical zero as perfect accuracy.
residual_equivalence.diagonal_scale_fix: Restores A and b after solve; preserves reused matrix consistency.

audit_options_note: Options-view/left are requested but no finalize table appeared in smoke stdout; critical settings are verified via the actual KSP view and pinned option parsing source, not assumed from that table.

ambient_options_audit.note: PETSc 3.19.6 reads PETSC_OPTIONS after rc files. Environment -skip_petscrc therefore does not prevent earlier rc loading. It is retained in the already frozen candidate but not claimed to provide isolation; actual absence of all rc paths was verified during short run. Future launcher checks absence before execution.
